scripts.validate: bun tools/anwa.ts validate demo/calculator/anwa.json demo/orders/anwa.json demo/reports/anwa.json
scripts.format: bun fmt src demo test tools
scripts.format:check: bun fmt --check src demo test tools
scripts.lint:check: bunx oxlint src demo test tools
scripts.codegen: bun tools/anwa.ts generate-manifest demo/calculator/anwa.json demo/calculator/contract.generated.ts && bun tools/anwa.ts generate-manifest demo/orders/anwa.json demo/orders/contract.generated.ts && bun tools/anwa.ts generate-manifest demo/reports/anwa.json demo/reports/contract.generated.ts
